utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I think we should start by sorting the donations and seeing what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll sort the donations and make a quick list of what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the exact time and where we’re dropping things off so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair point — can you confirm the exact time and drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can, but I still need the exact time and the drop-off spot before I can commit. Once you have those, I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right — I think I heard something about it, but I might’ve missed the details. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, sorry, I’m a bit fuzzy on the details too. I just know it’s still happening and I can check what changed for you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, that’d help — I probably missed the update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll mention the repair drive plans to folks around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate that. I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands, too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks — I’ll spread the word, and let me know if you hear anything useful while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — we’re still gathering tools and parts, and anything you can lend would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can bring by a hammer, screwdrivers, and some spare nails.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what needs fixing first, and when are we starting?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — let’s start with the safety stuff first, then the most urgent repairs, and we can kick off Saturday morning. I’ll spread the word and line up a few neighbors to help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good to me—please put the safety repairs first, and let me know what time Saturday morning we’re starting.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’m still on for the repair drive today. What time should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How about 3 PM by the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you check the community center for donated tools and bring them to the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check the community center for the donated tools and bring them over to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What do you want me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara — thank you. Could you help me keep track of the volunteer sign-ups and note which repairs each person is willing to handle?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll keep track of the sign-ups and note which repairs each person can handle. Just send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring a few supplies for the repair drive—just tell me what’s still needed, Bo.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — we still need tape, gloves, and a couple flashlights. If you can grab any of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can grab tape and gloves today, and I’ll see if I can find a couple flashlights too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is starting soon, and folks are already dropping off tools and supplies. If you need the details, I can go ask around.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Tess. If you hear the time and place, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — I’ll ask around and let you know as soon as I hear the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help, but I want to make sure I’ve got the repair drive details right first. What exactly do you need me to check?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you please confirm the drop-off time and whether we still need anyone to bring extra boxes?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the drop-off time and check whether extra boxes are still needed, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just bring any old batteries, light bulbs, or tools you’re ready to donate. If you’ve got a box or two, that’d help a lot too.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—I can bring some batteries and a box or two.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m in for the repair drive — I’ll swing by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Vik — thanks! We’ll be glad to have you there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll swing by and help out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might've missed the latest update, but I can help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’m just trying to get a few things together for the drive — I’ll let you know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good—just point me to whatever’s still missing, and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We could still use a drill, a step ladder, and a couple extension cords if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure thing — I’ll sort the donations when I can find a minute.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive moving, Opal. Let’s make sure we’ve got the list in order and know who needs help first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — I’ll keep the list tidy and start with the folks who need help most. If you’ve got names or addresses, I’ll organize them by location.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — I’ll gather the names and addresses, then we can sort them by street and urgency.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to confirm the timing and where everything should go first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the timing and drop-off spot right over, and then you can plan on it. We’d love to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — let’s say Saturday at 10, and I need a few boxes and a small dresser hauled over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening today—I just want to confirm the time and place first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, just confirm the time and place, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, but let’s keep it simple: tell me the time and what needs hauling, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — what should I sort first?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Start with the heaviest stuff and anything fragile. Then tell me what time you want me there, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting organized, though I’m still piecing it together from the neighbors. If you know what they need most, I’d really like to help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re short on screwdrivers, spare screws, and a few rolls of duct tape. If you can bring any of those, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can probably round up some screwdrivers and duct tape from around the block. I’ll ask a couple neighbors about spare screws too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to help, just remind me what I’m bringing and I’ll get there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great—could you bring a screwdriver set and a roll of duct tape? If you can be there around 10, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, screwdriver set and duct tape at 10—I’ve got it this time. I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school run, but I’ll need the repair drive details first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — it’s the repair drive for the community hall. I’ll send the exact time and list of items soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send them over when you have them and I’ll work it around the school run.
